name: flutterin
description: Reverse engineer anything to Flutter. One MCP server & CLI to inspect apps, decompile assets/logic, and generate clean Flutter code.

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/targets/binary', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/targets/binary/engineCatalogData.json', 'dist/targets/binary/engineCatalogData.json');"
scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/tests')) { const files=fs.readdirSync('dist/tests').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).map(f=>'dist/tests/'+f); const r=spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', ...files], {stdio:'inherit'}); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); }"
